theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (D : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (ν : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → μ K ≠ ∞) → Measurable ν → (∀ y, ‖ν y‖ = 1) → (∀ᵐ y ∂μ, Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μ (closedBall y r) / (unitBallVolume m * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ m))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1) ∧ Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μ ({z | (1 / 4 : ℝ) * ‖z - y‖ ≤ |inner ℝ (z - y) (ν y)|} ∩ closedBall y r) / ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ m)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)) → ∀ U : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), IsOpen U → IsCompact (closure U) → closure U ⊆ D → ∃ Γ : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), IsClosed Γ ∧ CountablyRectifiable m Γ ∧ μ (U \ Γ) ≤ μ U / 2
